name: Gobreaker
description: Detect breaking changes in Go public APIs. Compares git refs or filesystem paths and reports incompatible/compatible changes using golang.org/x/exp/apidiff.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `check` (Detect breaking changes in a Go project's public API).

Installs with `claude plugin install gobreaker@claude-community` from `flaticols/gobreaker`.

A command-line tool that detects breaking changes in Go APIs by comparing different versions of your code.
